content: Professor Edward W. Hook III serves as the Director of the Division of Infectious Diseases at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, located in Birmingham, Alabama, USA. He is a member of the STI Guideline Development Group, which has developed 92 guidelines for the management of symptomatic sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Rossaphorn Kittyaowamarn is affiliated with the Department of Disease Control, Bureau of AIDS, TB, and STIs under the Ministry of Public Health in Nonthaburi, Thailand. Jeffrey D. Klausner is a Professor of Medicine and Public Health at the UCLA David Geffen School of Medicine and the Fielding School of Public Health in Los Angeles, California, USA. Ranmini Kularatne is the Head of the STI Section at the Centre for HIV & STIs, National Institute for Communicable Diseases, Johannesburg, South Africa. David Lewis is associated with the Western Sydney Sexual Health Centre and the Marie Bashir Institute for Infectious Diseases and Biosecurity at the Sydney Medical School, University of Sydney, Australia. Nicola Low is an expert in Epidemiology and Public Health at the Institute of Social and Preventive Medicine, University of Bern, Switzerland. Philippe Mayaud is part of the Clinical Research Department at the Faculty of Infectious and Tropical Diseases, London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, United Kingdom. Daniel McCartney provides research and technical support for the International Planned Parenthood Federation in London, United Kingdom. Nelly Mugo is affiliated with the Kenya Medical Research Institute in Nairobi, Kenya. Saïqa Mullick is the Director of Implementation Science at the Wits Reproductive Health and HIV Institute in Johannesburg, South Africa. Francis Ndowa is based in Harare, Zimbabwe. Kees Rietmeijer serves as the Medical Director of the Denver STD Prevention Training Center at the Denver Public Health Department in Denver, Colorado, USA. Pachara Sirivonggrangsong is a Senior Advisor and Programme Manager at the Department of Disease Control, Bureau of AIDS, TB, and STIs, Ministry of Public Health, Thailand. Katayoun Tayeri is an HIV and AIDS specialist at the Iranian Research Center of HIV and AIDS, affiliated with the Iranian Institute for the Reduction of High-Risk Behaviors at Tehran University of Medical Sciences. She also serves as the National HIV/AIDS Care and Treatment Adviser for the Ministry of Health in Tehran, Islamic Republic of Iran. Ann Natalia Umar is the National STI Program Manager for HIV, AIDS, and STIs under the Subdirectorate of the Ministry of Health in Indonesia. Magnus Unemo is part of the Department of Laboratory Medicine, Microbiology, at Örebro University Hospital in Örebro, Sweden. C. de Vries is associated with the Amsterdam Sexual Health Clinics in the Netherlands. Hans Benjamin Hampel works at the University Hospital Zurich, Department of Infectious Diseases and Hospital Epidemiology, University of Zurich, Switzerland. Monica Lahra is part of the Division of Bacteriology at the WHO Collaborating Centre for Sexually Transmitted Infections and Antimicrobial Resistance, Department of Microbiology, Prince of Wales Hospital, New South Wales, Australia. Ahmed Latif is a Public Health Consultant in the Northern Territory, Australia. Ioannis Mameletzis is a Consultant for Key Populations in Ukraine and Sri Lanka. Angelica Espinosa Miranda is affiliated with the Ministry of Health, STI, AIDS, and Viral Hepatitis Department in Brazil. Koleka Mlisana is the Head of Medical Microbiology at the University of KwaZulu-Natal in Durban, South Africa. Lori Newman is part of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, Department of Health and Human Services, National Institutes of Health, Washington, DC, USA. Catherine Ngugi is the Head of the National AIDS and STI Control Programme at the Ministry of Health in Kenya. Lilani Rajapaksa is a Consultant Venereologist and Coordinator for HIV Care Services and the Elimination of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV and Syphilis Programme under the National STD AIDS Control Programme in Sri Lanka. Reshmie Ramautarsing is a physician at the Thai Red Cross AIDS Research Centre in Bangkok, Thailand. Danvic Rosadiño is the Senior Operations Manager and Data Protection Officer at Love Yourself, Inc., located in Mandaluyong City, Philippines. Janet Wilson is the President of the International Union of STIs and a Consultant in Genitourinary Medicine and HIV at Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust, Leeds General Infirmary, United Kingdom. The WHO Steering Committee includes Ian Askew, Director of the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research, and Theresa Babovic, Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Other members include Rachel Baggaley, Coordinator for Testing, Prevention, and Populations, and Nathalie Broutet, Medical Officer in the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research. Venkatraman Chandra-Mouli is a Scientist in the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research. Meg Doherty is the Director of the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Nathan Ford is a Medical Officer in the same department, while Sami Gottlieb is a Medical Officer in the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research. Cadi Irvine is a Consultant in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. James Kiarie is part of the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research. Niklas Luhmann is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Virginia MacDonald is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Francis McConville is a Technical Officer in the Department for Maternal, Newborn, Child, and Adolescent Health and Ageing. Yamuna Mundade is a Programme Manager in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Carmen Pessoa-Silva is the Unit Head for Surveillance, Evidence, and Laboratory Strengthening. Ajay Rangaraj is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Melanie Taylor is a Medical Officer in the same department, while Igor Toskin is a Scientist in the Department of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Research. Annette Vester is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Marco Vitoria is a Medical Officer in the same department. Lara Vojnov is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Teodora Wi is a Medical Officer in the STI Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. Mayada Youseff-Fox is a Technical Officer in the Department of Global HIV, Hepatitis, and Sexually Transmitted Infections Programmes. The WHO Steering Committee also includes regional representatives such as Massimo Ghidinelli, Unit Chief for HIV, Hepatitis, TB, and Sexually Transmitted Diseases at the WHO Regional Office for the Americas, and Joumana Hermez, Regional Adviser for Hepatitis, AIDS, and STDs at the WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean. Naoko Ishikawa is the Coordinator for HIV, Hepatitis, and STI at the WHO Regional Office for the Western Pacific. Hugues Lago is the Coordinator for HIV/TB/Hepatitis/STI Programmes at the WHO Regional Office for Africa. Bharat Rewari is a Medical Officer for HIV/STI/Hepatitis at the WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia. Nicole Seguy is part of the Joint Tuberculosis, HIV/AIDS, and Hepatitis Programme at the WHO Regional Office for Europe. Nancy Santesso, from the Department of Clinical Epidemiology and Biostatistics at McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, serves as the overall coordinator of the STI guidelines.
